source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Budgeting and Resource Management (PDF 134, printed 130).

blocks.text: Budgeting aur resource management mein yeh planning shamil hai ke business mein paisa, waqt aur doosre wasail kaise use honge. Budget entrepreneurs ko kharchon ka andaza lagane, qeematein tay karne aur aamdani aur kharche achhi tarah sambhalne mein madad deta hai. Sahi resource management yaqeeni banata hai ke materials, skills aur tools zaya kiye baghair achhi tarah use hon. Digital karobar mein achhi budgeting aur resource planning munafa (profit) barqarar rakhti aur lambe arse ki kamyabi mein madad deti hai.

Budget mein hum andaza lagate hain ke kitni aamdani (income) aur kitna kharch (expenses) hoga, aur bacha hua munafa (profit) kitna hai. Yeh program aik chhote online T-shirt business ka mahana budget banata hai (qeematein misal hain).

price = 1500            # aik T-shirt ki qeemat (PKR)
units_sold = 40         # mahine mein kitni bikin
costs = {"maal (stock)": 30000, "internet": 3000, "ads (social media)": 5000, "delivery": 6000}

income = price * units_sold
expenses = 0
for item, amount in costs.items():
    print(f"{item}: PKR {amount}")
    expenses += amount

profit = income - expenses
print("Aamdani (income): PKR", income)
print("Kul kharch: PKR", expenses)
if profit >= 0:
    print("Munafa (profit): PKR", profit)
else:
    print("Nuqsan (loss): PKR", -profit)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"price = 1500" aik T-shirt ki qeemat aur "units_sold = 40" mahine mein bikne wali T-shirts.
"costs = {...}": dictionary jis mein har kharch ka naam aur raqam hai (stock, internet, ads, delivery).
"income = price * units_sold": 1500 x 40 = 60000.
"for item, amount in costs.items()": har kharch ka naam aur raqam print karta hai aur "expenses += amount" se kul kharch jama karta hai: 30000 + 3000 + 5000 + 6000 = 44000.
"profit = income - expenses": 60000 - 44000 = 16000. Agar yeh manfi (negative) ho to nuqsan (loss) print hota hai.
Output: "maal (stock): PKR 30000", "internet: PKR 3000", "ads (social media): PKR 5000", "delivery: PKR 6000", "Aamdani (income): PKR 60000", "Kul kharch: PKR 44000" aur "Munafa (profit): PKR 16000".
Khud try karein: units_sold = 25 kar dein; aamdani 37500 hogi aur "Nuqsan (loss): PKR 6500" aayega. Ya price badal kar sahi qeemat dhoondein.

blocks.prompt: Aik business ki aamdani PKR 50,000 aur kharch PKR 42,000 hai. Munafa kitna hai, aur budget kis kaam aata hai?
blocks.explanation: Munafa = 50,000 - 42,000 = PKR 8,000. Budget kharch ka andaza, qeemat tay karne aur aamdani aur kharch sambhalne mein madad karta hai.

items: Budgeting: paisa, waqt aur wasail ka plan; kharch, qeemat, aamdani.
